body:
It does not support `@HostListener('click', ['$event'])`:

> Directive Button, Cannot find name '$event'. Did you mean 'Event'?

Proposed solution:

* Never pass in `null` to the calls of `convertActionBinding` / `convertPropertyBinding` in [type_check_compiler.ts](https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/master/packages/compiler/src/view_compiler/type_check_compiler.ts). Instead, pass in a simple implementation of a `LocalResolver` that returns `o.variable(DYNAMIC_VAR_NAME)` if asked for a local called `EventHandlerVars.event.name`.
